prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
Sorry to hear you were hurt — that’s stressful. I can help you choose the right lawyer, but first a few quick questions so my advice is useful:

- When did the accident happen?
- Are you still getting medical treatment? How serious are the injuries?
- Was there a police report? Were there witnesses?
- Do you know the other driver’s insurance status?
- Do you want a local Pleasanton lawyer, or are you okay with a lawyer based elsewhere in the Bay Area?
- Any language, availability, budget, or other preferences?

What kind of lawyer to hire
- Look for a personal injury attorney who handles car-accident cases (not a generalist).
- Prefer attorneys who regularly negotiate with insurers and who have trial experience (many cases settle, but you want someone who will take the case to court if necessary).
- Local experience in Alameda County courts is a plus.
- Clear contingency fee terms (most PI attorneys work on contingency — common ranges are about 33%–40% of recovery; confirm who pays out‑of‑pocket costs and how they are repaid).
- Good client reviews and verifiable settlement/verdict history.
- Clean disciplinary record with the California State Bar.

Immediate steps you should take now
- Get and follow medical care; document everything.
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicle, injuries, scene; medical records; receipts; contacts for witnesses.
- Obtain the police report number and copy.
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other driver’s insurer; provide basic facts and say you’ll work with your attorney.
- Don’t post details or photos about the accident or injuries on social media.

How to choose between lawyers (call/meet 3)
Ask each during the free consultation:
- How many car-accident cases do you handle per year?
- What percentage of your cases settle vs go to trial?
- What’s a typical case value for injuries like mine (based on similar cases)?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney or staff)?
- What are your fees and how are costs handled?
- Can you provide references or examples of verdicts/settlements?
- How do you communicate (email, phone, how often)?

Where to find and verify attorneys
- Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service.
- California State Bar’s website to verify license and disciplinary history (calbar.ca.gov).
- Review sites: Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Google/Yelp (read multiple reviews).
- Ask friends/family or other lawyers for referrals.

Statute of limitations (important)
- In California, the general personal-injury statute of limitations is 2 years from the date of the accident. There are exceptions, so don’t delay contacting an attorney.

If you want, I can:
- Look up and recommend several well-reviewed personal-injury attorneys or firms who handle Pleasanton/Alameda County car-accident cases (I’ll need your permission to search and any preferences), or
- Draft a short script/email you can use when calling attorneys for consultations.

Which would you prefer?
